question: Which of the following rivers flows from east to west?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narmada River**

 
 
• The Narmada River originates from the **Amarkantak Plateau** in the state of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• **It Flows in Westward Direction**
 
• The Narmada flows **westward** between the **Vindhya** and **Satpura mountain ranges** and drains into the **Arabian Sea** through the **Gulf of Khambhat** in **Gujarat**.
 
• The Narmada is one of the few rivers in India that flows **westward**, so this is the **correct answer**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahanadi**

 
 
• Mahanadi originates in the **Sambalpur district** of **Odisha**.
 
• The Mahanadi flows primarily **eastward**, passing through the state of **Odisha** and emptying into the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
 
 
• **Krishna**
 
 
• The Krishna River originates from the **Western Ghats** near the town of **Mahabaleshwar** in **Maharashtra**.
 
• The river flows eastward across **Maharashtra**, **Karnataka**, and **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• It finally drains into the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
 
 
• ​**Godavari**
 
 
• The Godavari originates from the **Western Ghats** near **Trimbak** in **Maharashtra**.
 
• The river flows eastward, passing through **Maharashtra**, **Telangana**, and **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• It eventually empties into the **Bay of Bengal**.
